evidence.tested_misconception: 甲種試験は乙種免状保有者しか受験できない。
evidence.reasoning_path: Kou eligibility -> chemistry education route -> eligible

collision.note: Batch 2 Tier A; distinct from C019 Otsu-license practical-experience route.

independent_review.rationale: Article 13-3(4)(1) supports the chemistry-education route to Kou examination eligibility; distinct from experience route.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract.
